justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/AnnotationAppender.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/AnnotationAppenderTargetTest.java`. `OnField` is a tiny adapter: one private `FieldVisitor` field, one constructor, and exactly two `visit(...)` methods, both of which directly delegate to `fieldVisitor.visitAnnotation(...)` or `fieldVisitor.visitTypeAnnotation(...)`. The test file only verifies those two delegations. This shows a single cohesive responsibility, with no evidence of excessive size or multiple separable concerns.
